extension.summary: ysp-live 央视频全频道直播网关（原生后台服务，自动配置 PVR）
ysp-live CCTV live-stream gateway (native service, auto-configures PVR)
extension.description: 在 Kodi 后台原生运行 ysp-live v9.0 直播网关，提供 64 路央视频道（含 4K/8K、省级卫视与 7 天回看）。无需 Docker。插件启动后会自动把 PVR IPTV Simple Client 指向本机网关，装完即可在 Kodi「电视」中观看，无需手动填写订阅地址，并已自动开启 7 天回看。适用于 CoreELEC / LibreELEC 及各类 Linux、x86 平台的 Kodi（需系统提供 Python 3）。仅支持家庭宽带环境。

Runs the ysp-live v9.0 streaming gateway natively in the Kodi background, serving 64 CCTV channels (incl. 4K/8K, provincial satellites and 7-day catchup). No Docker required. On startup it automatically points PVR IPTV Simple Client at the local gateway, so live TV works right after installation with no manual URL entry. Works on CoreELEC / LibreELEC and any Linux or x86 Kodi that provides Python 3. Home broadband only.
